framework_commit_scope: official source checkout used for API and deployment review
profile_policy: fresh self-hosted browser run for every task repetition
navigation_policy: request provides only the start URL; target must be reached by a recorded visible-link click
validation: provider status, exact observed URL, click action, structured output, and deterministic DOM evidence (independent live fetch for stable pages; timestamped run DOM captured before completion or structured output for Hacker News)
reported_cost_scope: Skyvern PostgreSQL workflow_run_blocks.llm_cost plus child steps.step_cost; not independently reconciled to a provider invoice
cost_cap_policy: No new run starts after cumulative reported LLM/proxy/CAPTCHA cost reaches the cap; a final in-flight run may cross it. If a completed run has no auditable cost, no further paid run starts.

task_summaries.task: Open Example Domain, follow its visible information link, and extract the destination heading.
Open the IANA homepage, follow the visible Root Zone Management link, and extract the destination heading.
Open Hacker News, follow the visible new/newest navigation link, and extract the first story title.

claim_boundary: Public, read-only micro-tasks only; results are not an official Skyvern benchmark score and do not measure general web-agent capability.
audit_mode: offline sanitized-result audit; no API call
